description: Composio connects AI agents to apps with managed authentication, tool discovery, and tool execution.
rules: The current Composio REST API version is v3.1, served at https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3.1. Prefer it for new code and new examples.

https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3 is the previous REST API version. It is frozen with pinned tool-version defaults and remains supported. Existing v3 integrations keep working and do not need to migrate.

On REST v3.1, GET /tools and GET /tools/{tool_slug} default to the latest toolkit version. To pin it, use toolkit_versions=00000000_00 for GET /tools or version=00000000_00 for GET /tools/{tool_slug}.

On REST v3.1, POST /tools/execute/{tool_slug}, POST /tools/execute/{tool_slug}/input, and POST /tools/scopes/required default to the latest toolkit version. Pass version=00000000_00 to pin it explicitly.
Only those five endpoints change version defaults. POST /tools/scopes/required is v3.1-only; the other four also exist on v3, where omission selects 00000000_00.
TypeScript (@composio/core) and Python (composio) SDK callers are already on v3.1 through the generated client; this only affects direct REST calls.
